scripts.//: Every delegating script ends in `--`. Without it, `npm run test -- --ci` expands to `npm run test --workspace apps/web --ci`, and npm eats `--ci` as one of its own CLI flags instead of forwarding it to jest — the step still exits 0, having silently run without the flag. The trailing `--` makes the expansion `... --workspace apps/web -- --ci`, which forwards. Same trap for `npm run e2e -- --list`, which otherwise runs the entire suite.
scripts.db:migrate: npm exec --workspace apps/web -- prisma migrate deploy
